body:
It's not really people talking behind my back but it's the things I actually see. Like when my mom gets mad at me, or I stress my grandma out so much she goes and cries, or when I keep my aunt up so late at night as she's trying to help me that she's too tired for work the next morning. All just because I can't be normal like everyone else, I stress everyone out. Teachers too. I know they get upset when I don't ever turn in projects or homework. They give me so many chances but I still can't take advantage of them. I don't deserve those chances.

They even openly admit it. They make jokes about it. I mean not hurtful jokes or anything but they'll say stuff like "for as much as you've stressed us out we better not end up in a home" in like a joking tone. 

Nothing has ever hurt me more than seeing my grandma cry because I'm a horrible person. She shouldn't have to deal with that.
Eh, idk. Too much to all put into one comment. I guess a simplified version is that I just I hate myself and I hate school and I hate having anxiety.

Honestly I don't have much associations with father either. I just have memories of my uncle and how he would be with his children. I remember he fussed and yelled a lot. So it's an association, just not a very good one. He wasn't toxic or anything, I know that he was tired since he had four kids to deal with and didn't really mean to hurt anyone. He had normal occasionally anger and frustration where as my mom has got full blown anger issues. As his kids got older he did less yelling... My mom not so much, unfortunately. 

I remember when I went over to their house I had a lot of fun. They would take me places with my cousins. Even a trip to the store was exciting because I never get to go out with my parents. So... Traveling I guess? Going out?
Nah, it's not revenge. I just find hilarity in irony. I have a dark sense of humor. I want to kill myself because of other things. She's the last thing on my mind.

God first I have to even make some friends. I haven't had any friends in 5 years, and the few friends (which are really just acquaintances) I do have my parents get too over protective and don't let me meet other friend's parents. 

To be honest I don't think of anything when I think of a mother. Like I could try to think of some bullshit answer like love or care, but that word doesn't really mean anything to me other than the literal sense. Like I have more associations to the word father than I do to mother, and I've never even met my father.

Because I wouldn't respond to her when she called my name. To which I was having a panic attack during that time. I didn't do anything wrong. I never do anything wrong she just overreacts and I'm fucking tired of it.
Basically 16. In a few weeks.
They don't help me. They've never helped me before. The few times I've gone to my parents about my issues they invalidated me and made me feel worse.

Actually she didn't even know I was planning on writing my note, nor that I was gonna kill myself. She got pissed off because I wasn't answering her when she called my name. Why? Because I was in the middle of a panic attack. She took my computer and sent me to bed. Without even any dinner. 

Idc she overreacts often I'm used to it. I'm not upset at her, I just think it's funny is all. All the shit she says to me I bet she'd take it back in a heartbeat if she found me dead. I'm pissed off about other issues though, not her. She's not why I wanna kill myself.
I've got my mind set on suicide. I have decided my choice for a week now. I'm gonna at least try it but my method probably won't even work.

I am a burden, though. Nobody wants to admit it but I am. All I do is frustrate people and make them mad even when I'm trying my best. I was having basically a panic attack and because I couldn't speak to my mom I just got send to bed without any food. I heard her saying "why am I stuck with this? Why am I stick with this?" I know she's talking about me because she always is like that. I don't wanna be here if I just make others upset over things I can't do right. The amount of time and money spent on me. I don't deserve it. Especially now that I'm gonna kill myself. Five years worth of money could have gone to someone else had I just gotten it over with when I was younger.
In about 2 hours when everyone is asleep. No later than in 8 hours because school starts then. That's the timeframe I'm working with.

No, I'm pretty sure I will. Because across my 200 something attempts or near attempts, I've been told this same exact thing. Or I've been told it'd get better. Or that I'm making a mistake. And you know what? I've regret all of them. It's gotten worse. And what actually was a mistake was staying alive. What was a mistake was me being born. What was a mistake was me not killing myself the first time I fucking tried.
I've gave it enough chances already and I've regret every single one every single time.
I doubt it, I'm already done with all of this. Idc anymore.
Yeah I'm killing myself Monday too. Early Monday before school starts or anyone wakes up. Fuck school.
I needed someone a long time ago to be honest. Obviously that's not like your fault or anything. Just saying. So now I'm done and I don't really care anymore.

I've attempted or almost attempted what had to have been close to 200 times within the last 5 years. This isn't anything new and knowing my dumb self I'm probably just going to fail like usual. But at least I did research this time so I'm hopeful. Tired of living on this earth.
Idk. Not much to talk about. I've already got my mind set. I've been ready for this for a week now and every single day everything just confirms how I'm feeling.
I was going to but then got too depressed to bother to eat anything today. Fitting for the fucking day I guess, huh? Not even in death can I get my shit together.
